documents.title: SB Energy to build and operate OpenAI's 1.2 GW Stargate data center in Milam County, Texas
documents.text: SB Energy will build and operate a 1.2 GW Stargate data center near Burlington in Milam County. In June 2025 the county created a reinvestment zone for the campus beside the Orion Solar Belt. No local opposition or moratorium was found in county coverage.

state.note: Assumption (human judgement, as the data map specifies for the state layer): chance the statewide pause and audit stop this project outright. Delay is not modeled separately.

events.title: Governor directs PUCT and ERCOT to audit data centers in the interconnection queue; ERCOT pauses Batch Zero
PUCT grants ERCOT good-cause exceptions for the audit timeline
Governor directs TCEQ to "halt all permits sought by data centers until the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) completes its audit"

approval.value: No zoning approval: Milam County has no zoning authority outside cities. Expect county platting, floodplain review and site permits.
approval.note: Texas counties have no general zoning authority (Tex. Loc. Gov. Code ch. 231), per Atria zoning jurisdiction. Hill County adopted a data-center moratorium in 2026 and rescinded it after a federal lawsuit argued Texas counties lack that authority.
approval.source: Atria: zoning jurisdiction + Texas Local Government Code
